<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex78032023-09-283" status="unreviewed"> 
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon 32b3-33a3"/>
          'di ni <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5245">gzhi gsum gyi cho ga lag tu blang pa'i rim pa nye bar mkho ba nyaMs su lung</rs> dang <rs type="work">mdo rtsa kar+ma ba taM</rs> rnaMs kyi dgongs pa <lb n="32b4"/> bzhin bkod pa yin la.|… ‹'dir dus nges 'jug rgyu yin_no› 
          Stan pa'i rtas ba so sor thar pa yi bslab pa so ngas <lb n="32b5"/> sbyong cho ga ga'i lag len rnaMs | <rs type="work">lung</rs> dang de <rs type="work">'grel</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">gnyag dbon chos rje</rs><note type="editorial">Possibly gNyag dbon bsod nams bzang po(1341-1433)</note> yi || dgongs pa ji bzhin <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4086">chog grub seng ge</rs>s bkod || 
         
         dngos po zhes <hi rendition="#Time">gshing pho khyi'i lo</hi>.| <hi rendition="#Time">sbron gyi </hi>‹<hi rendition="#Time">sa</hi>›<hi rendition="#Time"> nya'i <lb n="33a2"/> ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcwo lnga'i nyin.</hi> <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5757">yar rgyab kyi sa'i cha | pho brang rgyal chen gling gi kun ga'i ra ba</rs>r | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shAkya'i <lb n="33a3"/> dge slong jo stan kha che'i bsod snyom‹s› pa chen po</rs>'i ring lugs 'dzin pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5243">d+harma sid+hi sing ha</rs>s<anchor xml:id="a1"/> bkod pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
